about_the_game:
One day you're walking in the forest alone.. THEN BAM! You look down and a Rabbit has it's teeth sank into your leg. You think of the only reasonable thing to do.. WHICH IS TO SEEK REVENGE! 

Rabid Rabbit's is a Psychological Horror game where you catch/knockout Rabbit's. You use various contraptions to process them to get revenge or to sell their parts for money to buy parts to craft the various contraptions. Contraptions range from thing's like a skinning cradle to a "bunny blender". There are 20+ contraptions to earn money from. After use of each contraption you gain madness which unlocks the contraptions crafting recipe, you then maybe use those to process parts for money to buy the crafting components.

In Rabid Rabbit you will & can.

Hunt down those Rabbits and Kill Them.

Gain madness to unlock new contraptions.

Sell them for money to buy crafting materials for new contraptions.

20+ Contraptions

20+ Madness Levels

3+ Rabbit Types!

  • Madness is used a tech tree of sorts. You gain madness by using the contraptions.

  • Contraptions are makeshift machines you put the Rabbits in to process

  • You use process Rabbit parts to sell for money to buy parts to buy contraptions

  • Madness unlocks contraptions, Money buys contraptions

Expand your contraption empire!

Progress and end those Rabbits while making money!

content_descriptors.notes:
Graphical Stylized Violence.
Lot's of blood and gore in the games stylized art style. Nothing on the realism side.
